item.title: Florent Ibenge resigns as Leopards head coach
item.description: DR Congo national football team coach Florent Ibenge presented his resignation to the president of the Congolese Football Association on Wednesday.

item.title: Rwanda-Backed M23 Rebels Summarily Executed Children in Bukavu, UN Reports
item.description: The United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights said on Tuesday that Rwandan-backed M23 rebels committed summary executions of children in Bukavu when they entered the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo city.

item.title: US Sanctions Rwanda
item.description: The U.S. Department of the Treasury has sanctioned Rwanda’s Minister of State for Regional Integration James Kabarebe for the central role he plays in Rwanda’s support for the M23 rebels. It also sanctioned Lawrence Kanyuka, a leading member and spokesperson for the M23 and AFC rebel groups.

item.title: UN Security Council Calls on Rwanda to Stop Supporting M23 Rebels in DR Congo
item.description: The UN Security Council unanimously adopted a resolution on Friday that strongly condemned the ongoing offensive and advance of M23 rebels in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The 15 members called on the Rwanda Defence Forces to stop supporting the armed group and immediately withdraw from Congolese territory “without preconditions.”

item.title: European Union Suspends Defence Consultations with Rwanda
item.description: The High Representative of the European Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, Kaja Kallas, announced on Monday the suspension of defence consultations with Kigali due to the involvement of Rwandan troops alongside the M23 rebels in eastern DR Congo.
